2645-3230-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3230-3430-5475.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3360-3430-6006.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-950-1336.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-950-1336.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-1336.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

643-728-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-728-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1445-2267-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-3899-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2292-3413-4875.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-6006-6965.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7706.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4478-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2452-3249-5670-7173--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2150-2281-5231.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-3875-5921-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-5921-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-3875-5921-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2438-4616-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1978-2750-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
1978-2750-5168.description:
Cause Bloom Tender to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness, with a +1/+1 counter on it and with power 3 or greater

1978-3717-5517.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat

2104-4423-4426-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-4426-6886.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

527-2178-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-2178-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {1}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Selvala trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Selvala trigger, untapping it.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

2173-4423-4693-6491-6701.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-4423-4693-6491-6701.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-4423-4693-6491-6701.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
2173-4423-4693-6491-6701.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

3779-6323.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
3779-6323.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.

1669-5145-5231-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

710-2511-4775.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2232-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier is a copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
1479-2232-5361.description:
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 3 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 5, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 2, putting the permanent you returned in step 6 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

373-877-4484-5147.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-4484-5147.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ebondeath, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1283-1641-2034-4452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {2}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

486-2043-2320-2556.notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}.
486-2043-2320-2556.description:
During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Mnemonic Wall to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reset to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {7}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Reset choosing its other modes.

1950-1965-2500-4600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1950-1965-2500-4600.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Omarthis until end of turn.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

717-803-1742-4035.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Blood Speaker, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token that enters the battlefield as a Demon due to Arcane Adaptation.
Blood Speaker's second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1308-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2773-3197-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2773-3197-5017.description:
Give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, dealing 4 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

77-747-1636-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
77-747-1636-5168.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, causing you to gain life equal to the Shrine's mana value.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Shrine enters the battlefield, triggering Go-Shintai, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2396-2651-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Ophidian Eye attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
2396-2651-4869.description:
Activate Murderer's Axe's equip ability by discarding a card, targeting any creature.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.

776-1329-2709-5052.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-5052.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Kite Shield to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Kite Shield.
Cast Kite Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-2034-4907.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Tatterkite dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to its ability.
Repeat.
